bug_semantics: SiYuan's editor upload/drag-drop/paste path builds snackbar HTML by concatenating the OS/browser-supplied File.name (and a lightly extension-rewritten filename) into <li> strings with no HTML escaping, then hands that markup to showMessage(). showMessage inserts the caller string as HTML (innerHTML at introduction; later insertAdjacentHTML / innerHTML of messageVersion) with no sanitization. A crafted filename containing an HTML/script payload executes as soon as the user drops or pastes the file. In the desktop Electron app (nodeIntegration:true, contextIsolation:false) this is XSS-to-RCE via window.require('child_process').
flaw_origin: The unescaped filename interpolations and the HTML-inserting showMessage sink were first written in the 2022-05-26 public dump of the previously closed-source UI (f40ed985e10b0f8391d6c94367cc85b9b5fad6bd, '完整开源界面和内核'). Immediate parent e650b8100c22e7fd9b9e28c3866af72e0242784a has no app/src tree and none of the vulnerable strings. git log -S/-L show those interpolations unchanged until the 2026-08-04 escapeHtml wrap. The dump is a bulk first-write with no reconstructable public member commits.

reasoning: Vulnerability-first: CVE-2026-74902 is a published VulnCheck record, not withdrawn or rejected, describing XSS in SiYuan's file-upload validation when unescaped filenames are inserted as HTML. The first-party advisory GHSA-jf56-jrhq-j2qp (vendor 88250, 2026-08-04) pins the source to validateFile() in app/src/protyle/upload/index.ts reflecting File.name into showMessage, which HTML-inserts the string. That call site is present and unescaped at v3.7.3 and at the parent of the cited lockfix. The mechanism is real CWE-79 (desktop Electron config makes impact RCE). Version metadata is slightly wrong—there is no v3.7.4 tag, v3.7.4-alpha.6 is still vulnerable, and the escapeHtml patch first ships in v3.8.0—but that is a range error, not a false positive. BIC search used -S of the unescaped `${file.name}` interpolations and -L of validateFile, not an AI-marked commit hunt. The smallest public first-write is f40ed985e (2022-05-26 UI/kernel open-source dump): those exact interpolations and an HTML-inserting showMessage appear there and are absent from the immediate parent tree. The dump is large, but no public member commits, replace refs, or earlier path exist to decompose, so it is a valid surviving first-write BIC. Subsequent commits only tweaked timeout/msgId or later swapped innerHTML for insertAdjacentHTML; they did not introduce the unescaped filename HTML. AI judgment is from that BIC object only: human founder Liang Ding, no co-author/generated/bot trailers. The 2026-08-04 Daniel escapeHtml commit is the direct fix of the advisory call sites, not the introducer. Verdict NOT_AI.
